position_name: Business Development & Outreach Representative – Substance Use Treatment
subject: Following Up on Your Application — Business Development & Outreach Representative
body: Hi Beckie, thank you for applying to the Business Development & Outreach Representative role with us. It looks like your resume didn't come through fully on our end, so before we move forward I want to make sure we have a complete picture of your background. Could you reply with an updated resume, or a quick summary of your current role and relevant experience? Once we have that, we'll get you moving through the process. Thanks so much, Devanne
